title: TariBill
creator: kingklowor
summary: MIT-licensed merchant payment-link and invoice prototype with a browser simulation and Rust template design. The hosted page labels payments as simulation and identifies its merchant and transactions as fictional seed data. Payments are recorded locally; real wallet signing and mainnet settlement are future work in the README. The recording walks through documentation and its labeled interface diagrams, not a working payment transaction.
cardSummary: Explore merchant payment links, invoice checkout and receipt tracking through a walletless browser simulation and Rust template source.
